description: This is a shell script implementing a Git update hook for repository access control policies, including permissions for branches and tags, user and group access restrictions, and detailed rules for push operations.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs approval message and exits with success status to permit push/update.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs denial message and exits with failure status to block push/update.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to standard error for debugging or logging.
